payload.name: May or Shall
payload.description: 搜索并引用你的案件材料
payload.summaryOriginal: Search and cite your case file
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
May or Shall isa workspace for legal matters. You read the case bundle,
and every passage worth keeping becomes a card that permanently carries its
exact quote and its source: the document, the page, the paragraph.

Connected to ChatGPT, it lets you draft from that material rather than from
memory. Search everything you have saved across your matters, pull the
chronology in date order, and ask which paragraphs of a plaint still lack a
specific denial, which under Order VIII Rule 5 CPC risk being treated as
admitted. You can also save a passage into a matter from inside a
conversation, and it keeps its citation.

What ChatGPT receives has already been chosen and categorised by you, so the
material it works from is grounded and filtered rather than a pile of PDFs.

Built by a practising litigator. Free to use, and open source under the AGPL.
payload.longDescription:
May or Shall 是处理法律事务的工作区。你可以阅读案件材料包，每段值得保留的文字都会成为一张卡片，永久记录准确引文及其来源：文件、页码和段落。

连接 ChatGPT 后，你可以基于这些材料起草内容，而不是依赖记忆。搜索你在各个事务中保存的所有内容，按日期提取时间线，并询问诉状中的哪些段落仍缺少具体答辩，因而可能依照 CPC 的 Order VIII Rule 5 被视为承认。你也可以在对话中将段落保存到某个事务，并保留其引用信息。

ChatGPT 接收的材料均由你事先选择和分类，因此它使用的是有依据且经过筛选的资料，而不是一堆 PDF。

由执业诉讼律师创建。免费使用，采用 AGPL 开源许可。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PostFast is a social media management tool. This plugin connects your existing PostFast workspace so you can run your posting workflow in conversation instead of opening the dashboard.

Plan and schedule
Draft a post, choose which of your connected accounts it goes to, attach an image or video, and place it on the calendar for a specific time. Save it as a draft, route it for approval, or approve one that is already waiting. Review what is queued and remove a scheduled post. Supported accounts: X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, YouTube, Bluesky, Telegram, and Google Business Profile.

Check how posts did
Look up the performance of a published post, or how an account's follower count has moved day by day. Analytics cover Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest Business accounts, and LinkedIn company pages.

Add an account
Generate a link that opens PostFast's account connection flow when you want to add a new social profile.

How it works
PostFast connects to each social network under its own app registrations and platform credentials, and stores your drafts, scheduled posts, media and comment history in your own PostFast workspace. This plugin is a first-party interface to that product, not a generic pass-through layer. Some tools do call a platform live, for example when publishing a post, and each of those is labelled as such.

You sign in with your existing PostFast account over OAuth. Viewing accounts, writing posts, and reading analytics are separate permissions that you grant individually, and you can disconnect at any time. The connector also exposes comment management tools used by other clients, which are not part of the workflows described here.

payload.name: AI Detector by AI GPT Zero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check essays, research papers, articles, and professional documents for signs of AI-generated writing inside ChatGPT. This AI detector and AI checker analyzes text you provide and returns AI and human likelihood scores, sentence-level highlights, and review guidance. The interactive workspace keeps your original text and detection results together for a clear, focused review.

Use it as a ChatGPT detector when reviewing text that may contain AI-generated writing, an AI essay checker for academic manuscripts, or an AI content detector for editorial and business documents. The tool supports AI writing review by bringing overall scores and individual sentence highlights into the same view, helping you identify passages that deserve closer attention.

Paste text into the workspace, run an AI detection scan, and read the overall assessment. Inspect highlighted sentences, consider the review guidance, and compare the results with the surrounding paragraphs. This text-checking workflow helps you move from a general question about possible AI use to a closer examination of specific passages.

Educators and researchers can use the AI text detector to support the review of essays, assignments, research papers, literature reviews, and other academic writing. Consider the findings alongside drafts, citations, source material, assignment requirements, and discussion with the author. Sentence-level AI detection provides an additional reference for understanding the text within its academic context.

Editors, publishers, journalists, and content teams can examine contributed articles, blog posts, newsletters, opinion pieces, and editorial drafts for possible AI-generated content. Use the AI content checker during an editorial review to identify sections that warrant follow-up with the writer and to keep the discussion grounded in the supplied text.

Marketing and SEO teams can review website copy, landing-page text, product descriptions, campaign content, and client deliverables. Business teams can check reports, proposals, and other professional writing. The same AI writing detector workflow helps reviewers examine the text they receive and decide where additional context or author input would be useful.

Whether you need an AI text checker for a research manuscript, a GPT detector for an article, or AI-generated text detection for business content, the workspace combines an overall assessment with sentence-level detail. Review possible AI writing, inspect the highlighted passages, and use the results to guide a more informed conversation about the content.

Detection results are estimates and should be interpreted with context and human judgment.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中检查论文、研究报告、文章和专业文档是否存在AI生成写作的迹象。这款AI检测工具会分析你提供的文本，返回AI及人类写作的可能性评分、句子级高亮和审阅建议。交互式工作区将原文和检测结果放在一起，便于清晰、专注地审阅。

审阅可能含有AI生成内容的文本时，可将其用作 ChatGPT 检测工具；检查学术文稿时，可用作AI论文检测工具；检查编辑及商业文档时，可用作AI内容检测工具。它将总体评分和各句高亮汇集在同一视图中，支持AI写作审阅，帮助你识别需要进一步关注的段落。

将文本粘贴到工作区，运行AI检测扫描，并阅读总体评估。检查高亮句子、考虑审阅建议，并结合周围段落比较结果。这一文本检查流程帮助你从是否可能使用AI的一般性问题，深入到具体段落的细致检查。

教育工作者和研究人员可使用AI文本检测工具辅助审阅论文、作业、研究报告、文献综述和其他学术写作。应结合草稿、引用、源材料、作业要求及与作者的沟通来考虑检测结果。句子级AI检测为在学术语境中理解文本提供额外参考。

编辑、出版商、记者和内容团队可检查投稿文章、博客文章、新闻简报、评论文章和编辑稿件中是否可能含有AI生成内容。在编辑审阅中使用AI内容检测工具，识别需要向作者进一步核实的部分，并让讨论以所提供的文本为依据。

营销和SEO团队可审阅网站文案、落地页文本、产品描述、营销活动内容和客户交付成果。业务团队可检查报告、提案和其他专业写作。同样的AI写作检测流程帮助审阅人员检查收到的文本，判断哪些地方需要更多背景信息或作者说明。

无论你需要研究文稿的AI文本检测、文章的GPT检测，还是商业内容的AI生成文本检测，工作区都将总体评估与句子级细节结合起来。审阅可能由AI撰写的内容、检查高亮段落，并利用结果引导更有依据的内容讨论。

检测结果属于估计，应结合上下文和人的判断进行解读。

payload.name: Page2AI
payload.description: 将公开网页转换为 Markdown
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Page2AI converts a single public web page — only the URL you explicitly provide — into clean Markdown for LLM context: main content extracted, boilerplate dropped, headings, code blocks, tables and links preserved, optional YAML frontmatter with the source URL and title. On-demand and read-only: no crawling, no accounts, no data stored by the application. It does not bypass paywalls, logins, rate limits or any site's access controls; private-network and cloud-metadata URLs are refused; responses are capped at 10 MB with enforced timeouts and per-IP rate limits. The identical MIT-licensed engine is available as a local MCP server (npx -y page2ai-mcp) for fully private workflows.
payload.longDescription: Page2AI 会将单个公开网页（仅限你明确提供的 URL）转换为适合大型语言模型上下文的整洁 Markdown：提取主要内容并去除模板杂项，同时保留标题、代码块、表格和链接；还可选择添加包含来源 URL 和标题的 YAML 前置元数据。按需运行且只读：不会爬取网页、不需要账户，也不会由应用存储数据。它不会绕过付费墙、登录、速率限制或任何网站的访问控制；会拒绝私有网络和云元数据 URL；响应上限为 10 MB，并强制实施超时和按 IP 限速。相同的 MIT 许可引擎也可作为本地 MCP 服务器使用（npx -y page2ai-mcp），适用于完全私密的工作流。

It is built for document-intensive workflows such as legal research, regulatory compliance, corporate knowledge, due diligence, research, and document analysis.
payload.longDescription: Deep Document Search 将 ChatGPT 转变为私有文档知识库的强大界面。使用自然语言搜索和分析 PDF、Word 文件、扫描文档及大型文档集合；从数千或数百万份文件中查找相关信息；并获取准确、可追溯且引用原始文档的答案。适用于法律研究、法规合规、企业知识管理、尽职调查、研究和文档分析等文档密集型工作流。

payload.name: Sitelas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe the website you want. Sitelas builds it — the design, the words, the images, the pages.

It does not stop at launch. It reads the messages your contact form collects, drafts replies, updates your content, and checks which pages people actually read.

Every build lands on a private preview link first. Your real web address stays empty until you say publish. Publishing and connecting your own domain are always yours to do.

Sites live on a sitelas.com address, and you can point your own domain at one when you are ready. A full visual editor is there in the browser whenever you would rather change something by hand.
payload.longDescription:
描述你想要的网站。Sitelas 会负责构建，包括设计、文案、图像和页面。

网站上线后，工作仍可继续。它会读取联系表单收集的消息、起草回复、更新内容，并检查用户实际浏览了哪些页面。

每个网站都会先生成私人预览链接。在你明确选择发布之前，正式网址不会启用。是否发布以及是否连接自己的域名，始终由你决定。

网站托管在 sitelas.com 地址下；准备好后，你也可以将自己的域名指向该网站。如果你更想手动修改，浏览器中还提供完整的可视化编辑器。

It keeps changes tied to the connected OAuth workspace, shows a proposal before edits are applied, can publish an approved revision, and exposes publication status plus retained versions.
payload.longDescription: OrbitPage 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 阅读、编辑、预览、发布和恢复自己托管的网页。所有更改都与已连接的 OAuth 工作区关联；应用会在编辑生效前展示方案，可以发布经批准的修订版本，并提供发布状态及保留版本信息。

Through ChatGPT, users can check their credit balance, browse saved job listings, estimate generation cost, create or regenerate a letter, apply a professional LaTeX template (PDF), and export the final document — all without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: Coverlttr 根据用户上传的简历和职位描述，帮助创建针对具体职位的求职信。通过 ChatGPT，用户可以查看积分余额、浏览已保存的职位信息、估算生成费用、创建或重新生成求职信、应用专业 LaTeX 模板（PDF），并导出最终文档——全程无需离开对话。

payload.name: BulkPublish
payload.description: 发布并安排社交媒体内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BulkPublish is a social media scheduling and bulk-publishing tool. In ChatGPT you can see which social accounts are connected, draft or schedule a post to one or several of them at once, upload an image or video for it, publish a draft straight away, move or retry a post, find the next open slot in your posting queue, and read how recent posts performed. It publishes to Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and more.
payload.longDescription: BulkPublish 是一款社交媒体排程和批量发布工具。在 ChatGPT 中，你可以查看已连接的社交账户，一次为一个或多个账户起草或安排帖子，为帖子上传图像或视频，立即发布草稿，移动或重试帖子，查找发布队列中的下一个空闲时段，并查看近期帖子的表现。它支持发布到 Facebook、Instagram、X、TikTok、YouTube、LinkedIn、Pinterest、Threads 等平台。

payload.name: SEO&OH AI
payload.description: 查找录音的转写、摘要和思维导图
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 서앤오AI 녹음 앱에 저장된 녹음을 ChatGPT에서 바로 찾아보세요. 녹음 목록과 상세 정보, 전체 전사본, AI 요약, 마인드맵을 불러올 수 있습니다. 로그인한 본인 계정의 데이터만 읽어오며, 어떤 데이터도 수정하거나 삭제하지 않는 읽기 전용 도구입니다. 회의·인터뷰·강의 녹음을 검색하고 핵심만 빠르게 확인하는 데 유용합니다.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中直接查找保存在 서앤오AI 录音应用里的录音。你可以调取录音列表和详情、完整转写文本、AI 摘要及思维导图。它只读取已登录账户本人的数据，不会修改或删除任何数据，是一款只读工具。适合搜索会议、访谈和课程录音，并快速了解重点。

payload.name: Google Contacts
payload.description: 查阅已保存的联系人信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Google Contacts and directory entries to find people by name, email, company, or domain, then read contact details such as email, phone, address, birthday, and organization.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 Google Contacts 和目录条目，可按姓名、电子邮件、公司或域名查找联系人，然后读取电子邮件、电话、地址、生日和所属组织等详细信息。

payload.name: Box
payload.description: 安全访问 Box 内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and reference your documents
payload.longDescription: 搜索并引用你的文档

payload.name: Youanai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Youanai helps users search workspace posts, social feed activity, media, analytics, and Business DNA, then create image-backed drafts, generate media, update Business DNA, and schedule future social posts with OAuth-scoped workspace access.
payload.longDescription: Youanai帮助用户搜索工作区帖子、社交动态、媒体内容、数据分析和业务DNA，进而创建图文草稿、生成媒体素材、更新业务DNA信息，并通过OAuth范围的工作区访问权限安排未来发布的社交内容。

payload.name: Readwise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The official app for Readwise and Reader. 

This app allows you to have chatgpt semantically search through all of your highlights, and any content saved to your Reader library.

More than that, it can do basically anything you can do in Reader! Triage your inbox, organize your library, catch up on your feed, and much more -- just ask :)
payload.longDescription:
Readwise 和 Reader 的官方应用。

此应用可让 ChatGPT 对你的所有高亮内容以及保存到 Reader 资料库中的内容进行语义搜索。

此外，它基本可以完成你在 Reader 中能做的任何事！整理收件箱、管理资料库、查看订阅动态等，只需开口询问即可 :)

payload.name: Whatjobs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search jobs near you from across the web in one place. Enter a job title and location to find relevant openings, compare listings, and explore opportunities without switching between multiple job sites.
Explore opportunities across 77 countries, with new locations and job sources added daily.
The app supports 25 languages, making it easy to search and apply wherever you are. Whether you're actively job hunting or exploring new opportunities, it helps you find relevant jobs near you and take the next step quickly.
Available in: United States, United Kingdom, Spain, Germany, India, Canada, and more.
payload.longDescription:
在一个地方搜索全网的附近职位。输入职位名称和地点即可查找相关招聘信息、比较职位列表，并探索机会，无需在多个招聘网站之间切换。
探索 77 个国家/地区的工作机会，并且每天都会增加新的地点和职位来源。
应用支持 25 种语言，无论你身在何处，都能轻松搜索和申请。无论你正在积极求职，还是探索新的职业机会，它都能帮你快速找到附近的相关职位并迈出下一步。
可用地区包括：United States、United Kingdom、Spain、Germany、India、Canada 等。

payload.name: Newsmind — RSS for your AI
payload.description: 阅读和搜索你的 RSS 订阅
payload.summaryOriginal: Read and search your RSS feeds
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Newsmind connects your RSS subscriptions to ChatGPT. Ask what's new and get briefings from the sources you chose; search your feeds by keyword or by meaning; group the same story across outlets; star and organize articles; and set watches on topics so matches are waiting next time you ask. Read position syncs across conversations, and existing subscriptions import in one step via OPML.
payload.longDescription: Newsmind 将你的 RSS 订阅连接到 ChatGPT。询问最新动态，获取你选择来源的简报；按关键词或含义搜索订阅内容；汇总不同媒体对同一新闻的报道；为文章加星标并整理归类；还可以关注主题，让匹配内容在你下次提问时随时可查。阅读进度会在不同对话间同步；现有订阅可通过 OPML 一次性导入。

payload.name: HOUSE ’N’ STARS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HOUSE ’N’ STARS is a read-only AI-native luxury real estate dataset connector for ChatGPT.

It allows users to search and retrieve real public luxury property listings from the HOUSE ’N’ STARS structured dataset, including Monaco, the French Riviera, Dubai, Abu Dhabi and selected international luxury destinations.

The app helps ChatGPT access public property data such as title, location, property type, Sale/Rent status, price display, bedrooms, bathrooms, surface, features and public listing URL.

Listings are supplied by professional real estate agencies admitted to the HOUSE ’N’ STARS platform. The platform applies a curation and quality-control layer to support reliable discovery, structured presentation and a consistent user experience.

The connector is strictly read-only and public-data-only. It does not create, edit, delete, reserve, buy, sell or publish properties. It does not request or process sensitive personal data, payment details, identity documents, financial documents or precise user location. It also does not provide legal, financial, valuation or investment advice.
payload.longDescription:
HOUSE ’N’ STARS 是面向 ChatGPT
的只读、AI 原生奢华房地产数据连接器。用户可搜

索并获取来自结构化数据集的真实公开豪宅列表，覆盖摩纳哥、法国里维埃拉、迪拜、阿布扎比及精选国际目的地。可访

问标题、位置、房产类型、出售/出租状态、价格、卧室、浴室、面积、特色和公开列表网址。列表由平台接纳的专业房

地产机构提供，并经过策展和质量控制。连接器严格只读、仅使用公开数据，不创建、编辑、删除、预订、买卖或发布房

产，也不索取或处理敏感个人资料、支付信息、身份证件、财务文件或精确位置，不提供法律、财务、估值或投资建议。该功能为只读。

payload.name: Photo Metadata Remover
payload.description: 移除 EXIF、GPS 和元数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Remove EXIF and GPS metadata from photos before sharing. Photo Metadata Remover opens a private cleaner inside ChatGPT for JPEG, PNG, and WebP images. Inspect hidden location, camera, date, XMP, IPTC, and related fields, then download a separate cleaned copy. Processing stays in the widget; KamnevApps does not receive the selected photo or cleaned output.
payload.longDescription: 分享照片前，移除其中的 EXIF 和 GPS 元数据。Photo Metadata Remover 会在 ChatGPT 中打开一个私密清理工具，支持 JPEG、PNG 和 WebP 图片。您可以检查隐藏的位置、相机、日期、XMP、IPTC 及相关字段，然后下载单独的清理后副本。处理过程在小组件内完成；KamnevApps 不会收到您选择的照片或清理后的文件。

payload.name: Postiz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Postiz helps users manage social media publishing from ChatGPT. Users can list connected channels and groups, inspect platform requirements, upload or generate media, create drafts or scheduled posts, update provider settings, and review upcoming posts.
payload.longDescription: Postiz 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 管理社交媒体发布。用户可以列出已连接的渠道和群组、查看平台要求、上传或生成媒体、创建草稿或排期帖子、更新服务提供方设置，并查看即将发布的帖子。

payload.name: Capsule CRM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Chat with your Capsule CRM directly in ChatGPT and Codex. Ask who you should follow up with, find contacts, review your pipeline, prep for meetings, or get quick reports on what matters most - in plain, everyday language.

You can also ask to update custom fields on contacts, opportunities and projects. ChatGPT and Codex use your live Capsule data and respects your existing permissions.

Available on Growth plan and above.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中直接与 Capsule CRM 对话。用日常语言询问应该跟进谁、查找联系人、查看销售渠道、准备会议，或快速获取重要事项的报告。

你还可以请求更新联系人、商机和项目中的自定义字段。ChatGPT 和 Codex 会使用你的 Capsule 实时数据，并遵循你现有的权限。

Growth 及以上套餐可用。

payload.name: Superlist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Superlist helps users manage personal and shared tasks and lists from ChatGPT, including finding work, creating tasks and lists, updating due dates and notes, completing or deleting items, assigning work, and sharing lists with existing collaborators.
payload.longDescription: Superlist 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 管理个人和共享的任务及清单，包括查找工作内容、创建任务和清单、更新截止日期和备注、完成或删除项目、分配工作，以及与现有协作者共享清单。

payload.name: lolcv
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your lolcv account to find and read your CVs and cover letters, prepare tailored drafts from content you approve, and search job listings with source links. Choose from 98 CV templates, including 32 Pro designs, or 13 cover-letter designs. Restyle a CV into a separate copy while keeping the original. Pro identifies a design collection; all listed templates are currently selectable. Job filters may be sent to external providers; results may be cached or incomplete. Separate permissions control CVs, cover letters and job search. Open drafts in lolcv to review the layout, edit and export. Requires a lolcv account. Does not send applications, contact employers, publish, overwrite or delete documents.
payload.longDescription: 连接 lolcv 账户，查找并阅读你的简历和求职信，根据你批准的内容准备定制草稿，并通过来源链接搜索职位列表。可从 98 款简历模板（含 32 款 Pro 设计）或 13 款求职信设计中选择。重新设计简历时会另存为副本，保留原件。Pro 表示某个设计系列；目前列出的所有模板都可以选择。职位筛选条件可能会发送给外部服务提供商；搜索结果可能经过缓存或不完整。简历、求职信和职位搜索分别由不同权限控制。你可以在 lolcv 中打开草稿，检查版式、编辑并导出。需要 lolcv 账户。本应用不会代你投递申请、联系雇主、发布内容、覆盖或删除文档。

payload.name: Fellow.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access and act on your meeting knowledge instantly. Fellow connects ChatGPT to your meeting ecosystem, letting you search transcripts, pull key insights from summaries, and track action items with natural-language queries. You can also add talking points, notes, and follow-ups straight to your meeting agendas, so you walk into every meeting prepared.

Need to recall decisions from last quarter? Looking for action items assigned to your team? Want to reference that brilliant idea from yesterday's brainstorm, or add it to next week's agenda? Simply ask ChatGPT and skip the endless scrolling through notes.

Get the clarity you need, exactly when you need it, with Fellow's secure, centralized meeting intelligence.
payload.longDescription:
Fellow 可即时访问并运用你的会议知识。它将 ChatGPT 连接到你的会议环境，让你通过自然语言查询搜索转录文本、提取摘要中的关键信息并跟踪行动事项。你还可以直接向会议议程添加讨论要点、笔记和后续事项，让自己每次开会都准备充分。

需要回忆上季度的决策？想查找分配给团队的行动事项？想引用昨天头脑风暴中的精彩想法，或将其加入下周议程？只需询问 ChatGPT，无需再没完没了地翻阅笔记。

借助 Fellow 安全、集中的会议智能，在需要时获得清晰的信息。

payload.name: Hubstaff
payload.description: 面向 AI 的员工队伍洞察
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Hubstaff MCP server enables AI tools to understand and work with workforce data in real time. Analyze productivity trends, identify workload imbalances, surface operational insights, and interact with Hubstaff data through natural language and agent workflows.
payload.longDescription: Hubstaff MCP 服务器让 AI 工具能够实时理解并处理员工队伍数据。分析效率趋势、发现工作负荷失衡、提取运营洞察，并通过自然语言和智能体工作流与 Hubstaff 数据交互。

payload.name: TimePeace — Daily Log
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TimePeace is one calm, private place for your whole life — diary, journal, habits, mood, meals, exercise, money, people and travel. Connect the AI assistant you already use, and it can help you plan and keep that life, in plain language.

Ask it to turn a booking confirmation into a trip — flights, hotel and dates filled in — to build a week of training, or to plan your meals and add what you need to your shopping list. It can also log your day as you talk: a workout, a meal, an appointment, a note. Everything it adds is labelled as coming from your assistant, and it can remove only what it added — never your own entries.

You decide what it can touch. Adding to your diary is the baseline; reading your days back, and changing the things you've made (your trips, routines and meal plans), are each a separate permission you grant when you connect — never bundled, and health, people and money each need their own permission on top. Leave a permission off and those tools simply, honestly decline.

Nothing is sold, shared for advertising, or used to build a profile — no third-party trackers, no ads. It's your diary; the assistant is just another way in, working only where you let it.
payload.longDescription:
TimePeace是你整个生活的平静私密空间——日记、日志、习惯、情绪、饮食、运动、金钱、人际关系和旅行。连接你已有的AI助手，它就能用通俗易懂的语言帮你规划并维持这种生活。

让它把预订确认信息转化为旅行计划——自动填充航班、酒店和日期——来安排一周的训练，或规划你的饮食并把所需物品添加到购物清单。它还能在你说话时记录当天的活动：一次锻炼、一餐饭、一次约会或一条备忘录。它添加的每项内容都会标注为来自你的助手，且只能删除自己添加的内容——绝不会影响你的原始记录。

你决定它能操作哪些内容。添加日记是基础权限；回顾查看日期、修改已创建的内容（你的行程、日常安排和饮食计划）则需要分别授权——这些权限在连接时单独授予，不会捆绑在一起。健康、人际关系和金钱相关功能还需额外单独授权。如果未开启某项权限，对应的功能会直接且诚实地拒绝请求。

所有内容都不会被出售、用于广告共享或用于构建用户画像——没有第三方追踪器，也没有广告。这是你的日记，助手只是另一种访问方式，仅在你允许的范围内工作。

payload.name: Canva
Everygen
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Everygen helps creators generate and edit social-ready videos, images, voiceovers, scripts, ads, and captions directly from ChatGPT. Users can create standalone media or combine scripts, narration, generated scenes, and captions into finished short-form videos.
payload.longDescription: Everygen 帮助创作者直接通过 ChatGPT 生成和编辑适合社交媒体发布的视频、图像、配音、脚本、广告和字幕。用户可以单独创建媒体，也可以将脚本、旁白、生成场景和字幕组合成完整的短视频。

payload.name: Adobe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat. Describe what you want to make or change, and Adobe can help turn ideas, images, videos, and documents into polished outputs — from editing photos and creating PDFs to designing social assets, resizing videos, searching Creative Cloud assets, and generating data-driven documents.
Key capabilities:

* Retouch portraits or edit photos in bulk: Drop in photos and describe the look you want — adjust color, lighting, and tone; remove distractions and generate new elements; apply Lightroom presets; remove backgrounds; blur, crop, resize, and expand images.
* Design from template: Start from an Express template, update text and colors, and then animate for social media or convert to PDF.
* Refine video for any platform: Upload a horizontal clip and ask to reformat it for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or any platform. You can also stitch clips into a single sequence.
* Search and organize creative work: Describe what you're looking for and surface assets from your Creative Cloud library — by subject, style, mood, or content — without browsing folders.
* Work with PDFs and documents: Create and convert polished PDFs and documents.
* Create data-driven documents: Describe your output and provide your data — the connector turns raw data or content into formatted, shareable PDFs, including badges, cards, catalogs, and more.

You can get started as a guest, and sign in with your Adobe account for more capabilities and tools, Creative Cloud storage, and saved work across sessions.
payload.longDescription:
Adobe 让你在对话中拥有更多创作和完成工作的方式。此前以 Photoshop 提供的 Adobe 连接器，如今涵盖 Creative Cloud 和 Acrobat 的创意与生产力功能。描述你想制作或修改的内容，Adobe 就能帮助将想法、图像、视频和文档变为精美成果——从编辑照片、创建 PDF，到设计社交媒体素材、调整视频尺寸、搜索 Creative Cloud 素材，以及生成数据驱动的文档。
主要功能：

* 精修人像或批量编辑照片：添加照片并描述你想要的效果——调整色彩、光照和色调；移除干扰元素并生成新元素；应用 Lightroom 预设；移除背景；模糊、裁剪、调整尺寸和扩展图像。
* 基于模板设计：从 Express 模板开始，更新文字和颜色，然后为社交媒体添加动画或转换为 PDF。
* 为任何平台优化视频：上传横向视频片段，要求重新排版以适配 YouTube Shorts、Instagram Reels 或任何平台。你还可以将多个片段拼接为一个连续视频。
* 搜索和整理创意作品：描述所需内容，即可按主题、风格、氛围或内容从 Creative Cloud 素材库中找到素材，无需浏览文件夹。
* 处理 PDF 和文档：创建和转换精美的 PDF 和文档。
* 创建数据驱动的文档：描述想要的输出并提供数据——连接器将原始数据或内容转换为排版完善、可分享的 PDF，包括徽章、卡片、目录等。

你可以以访客身份开始使用，也可以登录 Adobe 账户，获得更多功能和工具、Creative Cloud 存储空间，以及跨会话保存的作品。

payload.name: MagicPath
payload.description: 直接在 ChatGPT 中设计
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MagicPath is an Al design and prototyping tool for creating interactive websites, app interfaces, dashboards, and visual plans on a shared canvas. With the MagicPath plugin, describe what you want to make and turn your ideas, notes, or existing designs into editable work you can explore and refine.

Create a landing page, prototype an app, or design a dashboard with working interactions. Compare multiple Ul and UX design directions, refine layouts and content, and apply reusable themes for a consistent look. Turn meeting notes, product requirements, or a process into flowcharts, wireframes, user journeys, and workshop boards that make the next step easier to understand.

MagicPath supports designers, product managers, founders, marketers, developers, educators, and teams planning how something should look or work. Keep related designs together in team projects and share links for review. In a coding environment with file access, adapt existing React Ul code into MagicPath or export React and TypeScript components to continue implementation in your app.
payload.longDescription:
MagicPath 是一款 AI 设计与原型工具，在共享画布上创建交互式网站、应用界面、仪表板和视觉化计划。通过 MagicPath 插件，描述你想要制作的内容，把想法、笔记或现有设计变成可编辑的作品，供你探索和完善。

创建落地页、制作应用原型，或设计带有可用交互的仪表板。比较多种 UI 和 UX 设计方向，完善布局和内容，并应用可复用主题以保持一致的外观。将会议笔记、产品需求或流程转化为流程图、线框图、用户旅程和工作坊板，让下一步更容易理解。

MagicPath 支持设计师、产品经理、创始人、营销人员、开发者、教育工作者和规划产品外观或行为的团队。将相关设计放在团队项目中并共享链接供审阅。在拥有文件访问权限的编码环境中，可以将现有 React UI 代码调整到 MagicPath，或导出 React 和 TypeScript 组件，继续在应用中实现。

payload.name: Figma
payload.description: 将 Figma 设计付诸代码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with your Figma designs
payload.longDescription: 使用你的 Figma 设计

payload.name: Riverside
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Riverside is an end-to-end platform for creating videos and podcasts. payload.name: Morphix
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Most creative work does not stop at the first generation. Morphix covers the whole path, from the first prompt to the file you actually hand over: every major image, video, and audio model in one credit pool.

Sign in with your Morphix account to get started.

With Morphix, you can:

• Generate. Images and video from text or from your own reference photos, including campaign stills, hero shots, posters, ad creatives and cinematic clips.

• Shoot. Product photography without a studio. Hero shots, lifestyle scenes, mockups, and as many variations as the campaign needs.

• Produce. Social and creator content, including thumbnails, UGC style product videos, faceless videos, reel covers.

payload.longDescription:
创意工作往往不会在第一次生成时就结束。Morphix 覆盖从第一个提示词到最终交付文件的完整流程：在一个额度池中使用所有主流图片、视频和音频模型。

登录 Morphix 账户即可开始。

使用 Morphix，你可以：

• 生成：根据文本或自己的参考照片生成图片和视频，包括营销静帧、主视觉、海报、广告创意和电影感片段。

• 拍摄：无需摄影棚即可制作产品摄影。根据营销活动需要，创建主视觉、生活场景、模型图和任意数量的变体。

payload.name: Autodesk Product Help
payload.description: 连接 Autodesk 产品文档

As a secure, read-only interface, it allows AI tools to search, navigate, and retrieve trusted Autodesk help content. Key Features:
- Ask support questions using natural language.
- Learn and onboard to Autodesk products faster.
- Create a foundation for AI agents and automation.
- Available in 10 languages: English (United States), French (France), German (Germany), Spanish  (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Italian (Italy), Japanese (Japan), Korean (Korea), Chinese (Simplified), and Russian (Russia)

No special requirements.

The world's designers, engineers, builders, and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make anything. From the buildings we live and work in, to the cars we drive and the bridges we drive over. From the products we use and rely on, to the movies and games that inspire us. Autodesk's Design and Make Platform unlocks the power of data to accelerate insights and automate processes, empowering our customers with the technology to create the world around us and deliver better outcomes for their business and the planet. For more information, visit https://www.autodesk.com.
payload.longDescription:
Autodesk® Product Help 模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器让 AI 智能体直接连接 Autodesk 的官方产品文档，覆盖 Autodesk Fusion®、AutoCAD®、Revit®、Inventor®、Maya®、Civil 3D® 等 110+ 款产品。它作为安全的只读接口，允许 AI 工具搜索、浏览和检索可信的 Autodesk 帮助内容，支持自然语言查询，加快入门过程，并为基于权威 Autodesk 产品文档构建的智能体提供可靠基础。

payload.name: Color Designer - Palette Maker
payload.description: 生成配色方案、设计和 Logo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Get perfect color ideas in seconds. Ask ChatGPT to suggest colors that work well together, then see them as a simple palette you can use right away. You can keep the colors you like, remove the ones you do not, change any color, or add new ones. The goal is to help you move from an idea to a useful color palette without getting stuck or spending a long time making small choices.

Every suggested color appears as a large color tile that is easy to see. If a color does not fit your project, tap the remove button. Want another idea? Add a new color. Need to fine tune a palette? Change a color instead of starting over. You stay in control while ChatGPT helps you explore new combinations. The result feels fast, simple, and playful, even if you have never worked with color before.

The app is made for anyone. You do not need to know color theory. You do not need to remember color names or search through huge lists. Just describe what you want, let ChatGPT suggest a palette, and make small edits until everything looks right. It works well for beginners, designers, artists, students, teachers, developers, and anyone making something that needs good colors.

A simple editing flow keeps everything easy to understand. Each color is shown as a big square so it is easy to compare with the others. The remove button is always nearby, making it clear how to take a color away. An empty tile with a plus sign lets you add another color whenever you want. Because every action is visible, you always know what to do next.

This makes the app useful for many kinds of projects. Build a brand palette. Pick colors for a website. Try ideas for a mobile app. Match colors for a game. Create art. Plan a room. Design a poster. Choose colors for a presentation. Make social media graphics. Find colors for invitations, stickers, shirts, or school projects. Even if you only want a fun mix of colors to inspire you, the app can help.

ChatGPT can suggest calm colors, bright colors, warm colors, cool colors, playful colors, elegant colors, nature inspired colors, seasonal colors, or almost any style you can describe. If your idea changes, simply ask for another direction and keep editing until the palette feels right. You are never locked into the first answer.

Because the palette is interactive, experimenting is easy. Swap one color instead of replacing everything. Keep your favorite shades while trying new accents. Remove colors that feel too dark, too bright, or too similar. Add another color when the design needs more variety. Small changes can quickly lead to a palette that feels balanced and complete.

The clean layout helps you focus on the colors instead of extra menus or complicated tools. Large color blocks make differences easy to spot. Clear controls reduce confusion. The interface encourages trying new ideas because changing your mind only takes a tap.

The app is also a great way to learn. As you explore different palettes, you naturally see how colors work together. You begin to notice contrast, harmony, and balance without reading long lessons. Every new suggestion is another chance to discover combinations you might never have picked yourself.

Whether you already know exactly what you want or you are starting with nothing but a simple idea, this app helps turn words into color palettes that are easy to edit, easy to understand, and ready for your next creative project. It combines ChatGPT’s ability to generate fresh ideas with a straightforward editing experience, making color selection feel less like work and more like play.
payload.longDescription:
几秒钟内获得理想的配色灵感。请 ChatGPT 推荐彼此协调的颜色，然后查看可立即使用的简洁调色板。你可以保留喜欢的颜色、移除不喜欢的颜色、更改任意颜色或添加新颜色。它旨在帮助你把一个想法变成实用的调色板，无需卡在原地，也不必花很长时间做琐碎选择。

每个推荐颜色都会显示为醒目的大色块，方便查看。如果某种颜色不适合你的项目，点按移除按钮即可。想要其他灵感？添加一种新颜色。需要微调调色板？更换某个颜色，无需从头开始。ChatGPT 帮你探索新的组合，同时由你掌控。即使你以前从未接触过色彩，整个过程也会快速、简单而有趣。

任何人都可以使用这个应用。你不必懂色彩理论，也不必记住颜色名称或在庞大的列表中搜索。只需描述你的需求，让 ChatGPT 推荐一套配色，再稍作调整，直到一切看起来恰到好处。它适合初学者、设计师、艺术家、学生、教师、开发者，以及所有需要为作品挑选好看颜色的人。

简洁的编辑流程让一切都易于理解。每种颜色都以大方块显示，便于与其他颜色比较。移除按钮始终就在旁边，清楚显示如何删除颜色。带加号的空白色块让你随时添加另一种颜色。每个操作都清晰可见，因此你始终知道下一步该做什么。

这个应用适用于各种项目：构建品牌配色；为网站挑选颜色；为移动应用尝试配色；为游戏搭配颜色；创作艺术作品；规划房间；设计海报；为演示文稿选色；制作社交媒体图片；为请柬、贴纸、衬衫或学校项目挑选颜色。即使你只想找一组有趣的颜色来获取灵感，这个应用也能帮上忙。

ChatGPT 可以推荐沉静、明亮、温暖、清冷、活泼、优雅、自然风、季节主题或几乎任何你能描述的风格。如果想法改变，只需提出另一个方向，并继续编辑，直到配色感觉合适为止。你不会被最初的答案束缚。

由于调色板可以交互，尝试不同方案很容易。只替换一种颜色，无需全部重来。保留喜欢的色调，同时尝试新的点缀色。移除显得太暗、太亮或彼此过于相似的颜色。设计需要更多变化时再添加一种颜色。小小的改动就能迅速形成平衡、完整的配色方案。

清爽的布局让你专注于颜色，而不是多余菜单或复杂工具。大色块让差异一目了然，清晰的控件减少困惑。界面鼓励你尝试新想法，因为改变主意只需点按一下。

这个应用也很适合学习。探索不同配色时，你会自然而然地看到颜色如何相互搭配；无需阅读冗长课程，就能开始留意对比、和谐与平衡。每一次新推荐都是发现自己原本可能不会选择的组合的机会。

无论你已经明确知道自己想要什么，还是只有一个简单想法、尚未开始，这个应用都能帮助你把文字转化为易于编辑、易于理解、可用于下一个创意项目的调色板。它将 ChatGPT 生成新灵感的能力与直观的编辑体验结合起来，让选色不再像工作，更像游戏。

payload.name: Amazing Drawing
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The best way to draw with ChatGPT!

payload.longDescription:
与 ChatGPT 一起绘画的最佳方式！

画出任何想画的内容，然后与 ChatGPT 讨论！

payload.name: B&A: Draw Sketches
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create quick sketches, diagrams, notes, and visual ideas on a simple whiteboard canvas. Use freehand drawing, shapes, lines, arrows, and text to map out thoughts, explain concepts, or brainstorm visually.
payload.longDescription: 在简单的白板画布上快速创建草图、图解、笔记和视觉创意。使用自由绘画、形状、线条、箭头和文字梳理想法、解释概念，或进行可视化头脑风暴。

payload.name: Screel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Screel turns an idea into a finished video without leaving the chat. Describe what you want and Screel builds a project as a sequence of scenes: it writes the storyboard, generates a still image for every scene, and can animate scenes into clips, add AI voiceover narration and background music, and render everything into a shareable video. Reference documents keep your characters, props, products and places consistent from scene to scene, whether they start from an uploaded photo or a picture made in the chat. Consecutive scenes can be derived from one another and animated with an end frame, so one action flows from clip to clip. Clips are generated at a low-cost draft resolution by default, with higher tiers available when you ask. Live widgets show the storyboard, job progress and the final player inline, and every project stays open in the Screel web app for timeline trimming, document editing and collaboration.
payload.longDescription: Screel 让你无需离开聊天即可将创意制作成完整视频。描述你的需求，Screel 就会将项目构建为一系列场景：撰写分镜脚本，为每个场景生成静态图像，还可以将场景制作成片段、添加 AI 配音旁白和背景音乐，并渲染成可分享的视频。参考文档能让角色、道具、产品和地点在各场景中保持一致，无论它们来自上传的照片还是在聊天中生成的图片。连续场景可以从前一场景延续，并使用结束帧进行动画处理，让同一个动作在不同片段间流畅衔接。默认以低成本草稿分辨率生成片段；提出要求后可选择更高等级。实时 widget 会在聊天内展示分镜脚本、任务进度和最终播放器；每个项目也会在 Screel Web 应用中保持开放，可用于时间线剪辑、文档编辑和协作。

payload.name: Deep Art AI
payload.description: 编辑并创建视频和图像
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Deep Art AI enables users to create high-quality visual content directly through ChatGPT using natural-language instructions. Users can generate entirely new images and videos from text prompts by describing the desired subject, visual style, composition, atmosphere, movement, or other creative details.

Deep Art AI is designed to make use of the latest and most advanced image-generation and video-generation technologies available. The underlying imaging and video capabilities are continuously kept up to date so that users can benefit from current state-of-the-art models, improved visual quality, more accurate prompt understanding, better consistency, enhanced realism, and the latest creative generation capabilities.

For video creation, Deep Art AI can submit video generation requests as asynchronous generation jobs. This allows users to initiate more complex video-generation tasks without requiring the entire generation process to be completed within a single interaction. After a video job has been submitted, users can retrieve its current generation status through ChatGPT, making it possible to check whether the video is still being processed, has been successfully completed, or requires further action.

Overall, Deep Art AI provides an integrated creative workflow within ChatGPT for generating images and videos, submitting video-generation jobs, and monitoring the progress and status of generated video content. By continuously leveraging the latest available imaging and video technologies, Deep Art AI gives users access to modern, high-quality visual creation capabilities through simple conversational, prompt-based interactions.
payload.longDescription:
Deep Art AI 让用户能够通过自然语言指令，直接在 ChatGPT 中创作高质量视觉内容。用户可以通过描述所需主体、视觉风格、构图、氛围、动作或其他创意细节，根据文本提示生成全新的图像和视频。

Deep Art AI 旨在运用可用的最新、最先进的图像生成和视频生成技术。底层图像和视频功能会持续更新，让用户受益于当前最先进的模型、更优的视觉质量、更准确的提示理解、更好的连贯性、更强的真实感以及最新的创作能力。

在视频创作方面，Deep Art AI 可以将视频生成请求作为异步生成任务提交。用户因此可以启动更复杂的视频生成任务，而无需在单次交互中完成整个生成过程。提交视频任务后，用户可以通过 ChatGPT 获取当前生成状态，以检查视频仍在处理中、已成功完成，还是需要进一步操作。

总之，Deep Art AI 在 ChatGPT 中提供一体化创作工作流，用于生成图像和视频、提交视频生成任务，并监控生成视频内容的进度和状态。通过持续采用最新的图像和视频技术，Deep Art AI 让用户可以通过简单的对话式提示，使用现代、高质量的视觉创作功能。

payload.name: Apixel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Apixel is an AI-powered image generator that turns your text into stunning visuals in seconds. It accurately renders text within images, making it perfect for posters, logos, and social media content. No design skills needed. Just type your idea and let Apixel do the rest.
payload.longDescription: Apixel 是 AI 图像生成器，可在几秒内将文字转为惊艳的视觉作品。它能准确渲染图片中的文字，非常适合海报、标志和社交媒体内容。无需设计技能，只需输入想法，其余交给 Apixel。

payload.name: Supericons
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Supericons helps people find and preview SVG icons by meaning, UI role, library, style, or supported language. It can recommend a consistent icon set for up to 20 parts of a product interface, show visual previews, and return exact SVG code when an icon is selected.
payload.longDescription: Supericons 帮助用户按含义、界面用途、图标库、风格或支持的语言查找并预览 SVG 图标。它可以为产品界面最多 20 个部分推荐风格一致的图标集，展示可视化预览，并在选定图标后提供准确的 SVG 代码。

payload.name: AI Color Picker - Design Tool
payload.description: 品牌、平面设计、标志、网站……
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pick any color you like and talk about it with AI. 

Tap, drag, or click on the color picker to choose a color. Then ask questions, get ideas, and learn what makes that color special.

There is no right or wrong answer. Just pick a color and start the conversation.

This app makes colors easy to understand. You do not need to know art, design, or color theory. The AI explains things in simple words. Ask why a color feels calm. Ask why two colors look good together. Ask what a color might mean in different places or for different people. The AI helps you learn one step at a time.

Try bright colors, dark colors, soft colors, or bold colors. Move around the picker to see tiny changes. Even a small change can make a color feel very different. Talk about what you see. Ask what changed and why.

Need help choosing colors? The AI can suggest colors that work well together. Explore matching colors, opposite colors, warm colors, cool colors, and balanced color sets. Make palettes for websites, apps, games, logos, posters, drawings, rooms, clothes, or school projects.

Want a happy feeling? A calm feeling? A strong feeling? A fun feeling? Tell the AI what you want. It can suggest colors that fit your idea. You can also show the AI a color you already picked and ask what other colors match it.

Learn about color harmony in a simple way. Find complementary colors that stand out. Explore analogous colors that sit close together. Try triadic colors for a playful look. Build monochromatic palettes from light and dark shades of the same color. The AI explains each idea with easy examples.

Discover what colors can mean. Red can feel exciting. Blue can feel peaceful. Green can remind people of nature. Yellow can feel bright and cheerful. Purple can feel rich or magical. Black can feel bold. White can feel clean. These ideas are common, but they are not rules. The AI can explain different views from around the world.

Working on a design? Ask for ideas for buttons, backgrounds, text, icons, charts, banners, or menus. Building a brand? Explore colors for logos, products, packaging, and marketing. Decorating a room? Compare paint colors and ask how they might look together. Picking clothes? Ask which colors work well for outfits.

If you know color codes, the AI can help with those too. Talk about HEX, RGB, HSL, and other common color formats. Ask how colors change on screens. Learn how brightness, saturation, and hue work. If you are new to these ideas, the AI explains them in plain language.

Accessibility matters. Ask how easy it is to read text on a color. Learn why some color pairs are easier to see than others. Explore better color choices for people with different kinds of color vision. Small changes can make designs easier for everyone to use.

This app is great for students, teachers, artists, designers, developers, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who enjoys colors. You can ask simple questions or deep questions. You can explore for one minute or one hour. Every conversation starts with the color you choose.

Try fun games too. Ask the AI to guess what a color reminds you of. Ask for color trivia. Build a rainbow. Find colors that match the seasons. Explore colors from nature, space, oceans, forests, flowers, food, animals, or famous works of art. Make up stories inspired by colors or invent names for your favorite shades.

There is always something new to discover. Every color has its own story. Every small change creates a new idea. Pick a color, ask a question, and keep exploring. Whether you want to learn, create, compare, imagine, or simply play with colors, this app gives you an easy and friendly way to turn every color into a conversation.
payload.longDescription:
选一个你喜欢的颜色，与 AI 聊聊它。

轻触、拖动或点击取色器来选择颜色。然后提出问题、获取灵感，了解这个颜色有什么特别之处。

没有对错之分。只需选一个颜色，就可以开始对话。

这款应用让颜色变得容易理解。你不需要懂美术、设计或色彩理论。AI 会用简单的语言解释。问问为什么某种颜色让人感到平静，为什么两种颜色搭配起来好看，或者某种颜色在不同地方、对不同人意味着什么。AI 帮助你一步一步学习。

尝试明亮、深暗、柔和或鲜明的颜色。在取色器上移动，观察细微变化。即使很小的变化，也能让颜色给人的感觉大不相同。聊聊你看到的变化，问问变了什么以及为什么。

需要帮助挑选颜色？AI 可以推荐搭配得好的颜色。探索协调色、对比色、暖色、冷色以及均衡的配色组合。为网站、应用、游戏、标志、海报、绘画、房间、服装或学校项目制作调色板。

想要快乐、平静、强烈或有趣的感觉？告诉 AI 你的想法。它可以推荐适合你创意的颜色。你也可以把已经选好的颜色展示给 AI，询问还有哪些颜色与它搭配。

用简单的方式了解色彩和谐。寻找醒目的互补色，探索色环上彼此相邻的类似色，尝试三角色配色，营造活泼的效果。用同一种颜色的深浅色调构建单色调色板。AI 会用易懂的例子解释每个概念。

探索颜色可能表达的含义。红色可以让人兴奋，蓝色可以让人平静，绿色可以让人想到自然，黄色可以显得明亮欢快，紫色可以显得华贵或神秘，黑色可以显得大胆，白色可以显得洁净。这些是常见的看法，但不是规则。AI 可以解释世界各地的不同观点。

正在做设计？询问按钮、背景、文字、图标、图表、横幅或菜单的设计思路。正在打造品牌？探索标志、产品、包装和营销的用色。正在装饰房间？比较油漆颜色，询问它们搭配起来会有什么效果。正在挑选衣服？询问哪些颜色适合搭配成一套穿着。

如果你懂颜色代码，AI 也能提供帮助。讨论 HEX、RGB、HSL 和其他常见颜色格式。询问颜色在屏幕上如何变化，了解亮度、饱和度和色相的作用。如果你刚接触这些概念，AI 会用通俗语言解释。

无障碍使用很重要。询问在某种背景色上阅读文字是否容易，了解为什么有些颜色组合比其他组合更容易辨识，为具有不同色觉的人探索更合适的配色。小小的调整就能让设计对每个人都更易用。

这款应用适合学生、教师、艺术家、设计师、开发者、创作者、爱好者，以及任何喜欢颜色的人。你可以问简单的问题，也可以问深入的问题。可以探索一分钟，也可以探索一小时。每次对话都从你选择的颜色开始。

也可以尝试有趣的游戏。让 AI 猜猜某种颜色让你联想到什么，询问色彩趣闻，构建一道彩虹，寻找与四季相配的颜色。探索自然、太空、海洋、森林、花朵、食物、动物或著名艺术作品中的颜色。编写受颜色启发的故事，或为你喜欢的色调起名字。

总有新发现等待着你。每种颜色都有自己的故事，每一点细微变化都会带来新想法。选一个颜色，问一个问题，继续探索。无论你想学习、创作、比较、想象，还是单纯玩转颜色，这款应用都能用轻松友好的方式，让每一种颜色成为话题。

payload.name: Font Pairing: Design & Brands
payload.description: 生成 UI 字体组合
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AI Font pairing for Designers.

Find beautiful font combinations in seconds with AI. Instead of trying dozens of fonts by hand, describe your project and get a complete font trio made for it. Each triplet includes a heading font, an accent font, and a body font that work well together. Whether you are building a website, designing a logo, creating a brand, making a presentation, or working on a social media post, this tool helps you choose fonts with less guesswork and more confidence.

Good typography can make a design feel clean, modern, friendly, bold, elegant, or playful. Picking the right fonts is often one of the hardest parts of design. Many fonts look great on their own but do not look good together. This app helps solve that problem. Tell the AI about your project, your audience, or the feeling you want, and it suggests font triplets that match your goals.

You can ask for styles like minimal, luxury, vintage, futuristic, editorial, corporate, creative, fun, classic, or high-tech. You can also describe your audience, your industry, or your brand personality. The AI uses your ideas to recommend fonts that fit the mood while keeping the design easy to read.

Every recommendation includes three fonts with different jobs. The heading font grabs attention. The accent font adds personality. The body font keeps long text clear and comfortable to read. Together they create a balanced typography system that is easier to use across websites, apps, presentations, posters, packaging, marketing materials, and more.

The app is useful for graphic designers, UI and UX designers, web designers, product designers, marketers, students, content creators, agencies, freelancers, startup founders, and anyone who wants better typography without spending hours testing font combinations.

You can keep asking for new ideas until you find the style you like. Try different moods, industries, audiences, or visual directions. Ask for alternatives, compare different looks, or explore fresh creative ideas. The AI can help you move from rough concepts to polished typography much faster than searching through large font libraries.

Whether you need fonts for a modern landing page, a restaurant menu, a fashion brand, a technology company, a portfolio, a mobile app, a book cover, a newsletter, or an event poster, the app helps you discover combinations that fit the project.

This tool works well during brainstorming, early design exploration, and final design decisions. It can help you avoid common pairing mistakes and give you inspiration when you feel stuck. It is also useful when you want to experiment with styles you might not have considered before.

If you already have one font picked, you can ask for matching options to complete the set. If you only know the feeling you want, the AI can start from that instead. The conversation is flexible, making it easy to refine results until they match your vision.

Instead of spending time comparing endless font lists, start with a strong typography system designed around your project. Save time, discover new ideas, and create designs with more consistency using AI-powered font triplets built for real design work.

payload.name: Beautiful.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Beautiful.ai ChatGPT app helps you skip the blank slide and turn rough ideas into clear, work-ready presentations in seconds. Brainstorm, draft, and refine your content directly in ChatGPT, then instantly transform it into a beautifully designed presentation. Add slides, update content, or restructure the entire flow all within the chat, or open your deck in Beautiful.ai for full creative control. Perfect for pitches, reports, strategy discussions, or any deck you need fast without sacrificing quality. Use it to:

- Turn chat conversations into ready-to-share presentations
- Repurpose documents or notes as slides in minutes
- Quickly build polished sales, marketing, product, or leadership decks that stay on brand
- Convert rough ideas or bullet points into clear, actionable recap decks
- Generate new decks by mentioning or tagging @beautiful.ai in your chat

Stop spending hours designing slides. Connect the Beautiful.ai app, or simply tag @beautiful.ai in ChatGPT, and see your content come together instantly.
payload.longDescription:
Beautiful.ai ChatGPT 应用帮助你跳过空白幻灯片，在几秒内将初步想法变成清晰、可用于工作的演示文稿。直接在 ChatGPT 中构思、起草和完善内容，然后立即将其转换为设计精美的演示文稿。你可以在聊天中添加幻灯片、更新内容或重组整个叙事流程，也可以在 Beautiful.ai 中打开演示文稿，获得完整的创作控制权。适合推介、报告、战略讨论，或任何需要快速完成且保持质量的演示文稿。使用它可以：

- 将聊天对话转换为可直接分享的演示文稿
- 在几分钟内将文档或笔记改编为幻灯片
- 快速构建符合品牌风格的精美销售、营销、产品或领导层演示文稿
- 将初步想法或要点转换为清晰、可执行的回顾演示文稿
- 在聊天中提及或标记 @beautiful.ai，生成新演示文稿

不必再花数小时设计幻灯片。连接 Beautiful.ai 应用，或直接在 ChatGPT 中标记 @beautiful.ai，即可看到内容立即成形。

payload.name: UX Pilot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UX Pilot helps users create wireframes, high-fidelity UI screens, and multi-screen app flows from natural-language prompts inside ChatGPT. Single-screen requests start generation in the user's UX Pilot workspace right away and show a live preview widget. Multi-screen flow requests first suggest screens; the user confirms selections in the widget before designs are generated. Users can open results in UX Pilot to continue editing.
payload.longDescription: UX Pilot 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中根据自然语言提示创建线框图、高保真 UI 屏幕和多屏应用流程。单屏请求会立即在用户的 UX Pilot 工作区中开始生成，并显示实时预览组件。对于多屏流程请求，系统会先建议屏幕；用户在组件中确认选择后才会生成设计。用户可以在 UX Pilot 中打开结果并继续编辑。
